dagger.description: A sharp blade, you can feel that too much pressure would cut your finger.
dagger.flavourtext: You take a <y>dagger<y> from its position on the bench

book.description: A book, the cover is made out of some sort of card. You tried to read it but you're blind.
book.flavourtext: You take the <y>book<y> from the table

tablet.description: A strange tablet small enough to fit in the palm of your hand, you aren't sure why but you feel like it might open some doors.

coins.description: A pile of coins looted from an unfortunate soul that was trapped here with you, this could be valuable.

key.description: A smooth key, made of an unknown metal.

hammer.description: A hammer, a strangely familiar object for where you find yourself.
hammer.flavourtext: You take the <y>hammer<y> from its place on the ground, it is cumbersome but comforting.

elixir.description: A strange elixir, it smells retched and bitter, The memory of its revolting taste makes you shiver.

sheet.description:
Trying really hard to read the braille on the sheet, you make out a few words at the top: 
"REGARDING THE SUMMONING OF COWS..." it doesn't seem very important 

come to think of it, you aren't sure how you know how to read braille, 
or even if you read that properly
sheet.flavourtext: You pick up the <y>sheet<y>;feeling it, you think it might be braille?
